extensionDescription.message: Adds buttons to Steam store pages that open or download the game in Hydra Plus.

downloadTooltip.message: Opens the game in Hydra Plus with the best download chosen.

openTooltip.message: Opens the game's page in Hydra Plus.

optionsShowOpen.message: Show the "Open in Hydra Plus" button

optionsHint.message: The first click asks your browser for permission to open Hydra Plus. Tick "Always allow" to skip the question next time. Whether a download starts right away is set in Hydra Plus under Settings → Downloads.
